name: identity_library_remove
title: Remove saved Brand Studio asset
description: App-only Brand Studio delete lifecycle. Removes an account-owned saved Signature asset or music bed from the library. If the removed asset is currently a project default anywhere in the account, that role is cleared for future reels and existing/frozen reels keep their baked identity values.

project_id.description: Project public ID used for edit authorization and refreshed shelf state.

library_entry_id.description: Saved identity library entry ID (ilib_...) or music-bed library ID (bed_...).
